title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (char ≠ 2, over a base S). E_0 is an elliptic curve and Σ = E_0/{±1} ≅ P^1_S is its Kummer line. The branch divisor D of E_0 → Σ is the image of the 2-torsion {}_2E_0, which is étale of rank 4. It splits as I_t = J ⊔ t(S), where t is the image of the origin and J is the image of the three nonzero 2-torsion points. The previous page reduced the data (E, σ) to the case E = E_0, I = {}_2E_0 = V, the trivial torsor. The point is that everything can be phrased in terms of the marked line (Σ_J, t). The marginal NB says that as an S-scheme I_t does not depend on t, up to canonical isomorphism.

The group V ≅ {}_2E_0 acts on I by translation. That action extends to an action on Σ_J that depends on t: translation by a 2-torsion point commutes with -1, so it descends to Σ.

(30) Multiplication by 2 on E_0 descends to a degree-4 endomorphism f_2^t: Σ_J → Σ_J. In modern language this is the Lattès map attached to [2]. Grothendieck wants to characterize it purely from (Σ_J, J, t). The marginal note says it is the map deduced from 2·id_{E_0} by passing to the quotient.

(32) The characterization goes as follows.
- For i ∈ J let σ_i^t be the involution of Σ_J exchanging t ↔ i and j ↔ k. This is translation by e_i, descended to Σ.
- Its fixed subscheme Δ_i^t has degree 2. A point P has x(P + e_i) = x(P) iff P + e_i = ±P, and since e_i ≠ 0 this means 2P = e_i. So Δ_i^t is the image of the halves of e_i.
- Hence f_t(Δ_i^t) ⊂ ξ_i, the section of D_J labelled i.

(33) The construction automatically gives f_t(J_S ∪ t(S)) ⊂ t(S), because 2·(2-torsion) = 0.

On the next page Grothendieck works this out for J = {0, 1, ∞}.
- The involutions are σ_0^t = (z-t)/(z-1), σ_1^t = t/z and σ_∞^t = t(z-1)/(z-t).
- Since the fibers of f over 0, 1, ∞ are Δ_0, Δ_1, Δ_∞ with multiplicity 2, one gets f(z) = t((z²-2z+t)/(z²-2tz+t))².
- This is a Möbius-renormalized form of the classical duplication formula x(2P) = (x²-λ)²/(4x(x-1)(x-λ)), with the image of the origin moved from ∞ to t.

Purpose: an explicit, coordinate-light description of level-2 data and of the λ-line moduli of elliptic curves in characteristic ≠ 2. The marginal remark suggests he wanted to stop being 'naive' and bring the elliptic curves back in properly.
errors: The conditions (32) as written only say f(Δ_i^t) ⊂ ξ_i. Uniqueness ('défini sans ambiguïté') also needs the degree (4) and the multiplicity-2 condition, which are only made explicit on the next page in (36). With those added, the zeros and poles fix f up to a unit, and the third condition fixes the unit.

Minor: the parenthetical about E_0 being determined 'à isom. (non uniques) près' is left incomplete. The (P^1, 4 points) data recovers E_0 only up to non-unique isomorphism, or only étale-locally as a torsor. This is a correct caveat but it is not developed.

ideas.what: Descent of multiplication by 2 on E_0 to a degree-4 endomorphism of the Kummer line Σ = E_0/±1
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Weierstrass/Jacobi duplication formulas); Lattès 1918 in dynamics

ideas.what: Translations by 2-torsion descend to involutions of P^1 permuting the four branch points as the Klein four-group; their fixed points are the images of the halves of the 2-torsion points
ideas.modern_name: Klein four-group action on the Kummer line / level-2 structure
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Klein; theory of the Legendre λ-line)

ideas.what: Characterizing [2] on the Kummer line purely from the marked P^1 (J plus the section t) via fixed loci of the Klein involutions
ideas.modern_name: Fiber-prescribed characterization of the Lattès map

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful but classical reconstruction of the duplication (Lattès) map on the Legendre/Kummer line from level-2 data. It is correct and nicely formulated in terms of the Klein involutions, but contains nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: In (30) the map label appears to be f_2^t, i.e. subscript 2 and superscript t, rather than a deleted '2'. This is consistent with f_2^t on the next page.
The left marginal note probably reads 'il faudrait revenir moins naïvement à des considérations ... faire intervenir des courbes elliptiques'. The reading 'devenir moins naïf' is uncertain.
The parenthetical likely reads 'ce qui en effet détermine E_0, à isom. (non uniques) près, à isom. près pour la top. étale ...' rather than 'dit ... fg. ét.'
